opening.argument: The video explains tokenomics through a five-part framework covering supply, distribution, vesting, utility, and burns. It presents that framework as a way to evaluate any coin, while describing Pi and Core as different economic models rather than declaring either one better. Its discussion of scarcity and burns is conditional: possible value depends on demand, and reduced supply is described as an effect for long-term holders, not a guaranteed return. The explicit warning that crypto is high risk reinforces the informational nature of the discussion. Nothing in these statements amounts to a specific purchase offer or a promised outcome.
